items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Niels Orsted, but the interviewee (Sam Jones) does not respond with any personal connection, only the interviewer's statement.

ctx.x: In other words, they don't want to listen to no one else, you see. Oh man, when I first heard this bass player over in Denmark, the black players don't want to give this man credit yet but man this is the baddest man I ever heard in my life on the bass. Niels Orsted.
